manifest.name: dsh-math-memory
manifest.description: Obsidian side-panel math memory agent for DeepSeek Harness: layered long-term memory, idea memo with proactive review reminders, unified note_recall retrieval plus dedicated note search/create/backlink tools. Ships as both a dsh plugin and an Obsidian community plugin.

bundle.text:
# dsh-math-memory bundle patch: inserts the host plugin into the profile
# roster. Applied as a profile bundle layer (the `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest
# field) after dsh-base + dsh-web-app; activate with
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-math-memory
#
# The row is a bare plugin by package name: the node half (the package's main
# export) runs in the host process and registers the /memory-panel routes plus
# the vault workspace. No browser half in this channel.
#
# The preset below names its modules as SUBPATHS OF THIS INSTALLED PACKAGE
# (`dsh-math-memory/dsh/preset/math-memory.mjs`) rather than as `./…` files in
# the profile directory. That is deliberate and is the only shape that survives a
# COLD FIRST BOOT: the registry mounts a preset's rows while the host row above
# is still being imported, so anything the host has to stage is one boot too
# late — measured 2026-09-26, `broken: "math-memory (./math-memory.mjs): never
# started"` on the first boot and fine on the second. The Obsidian/`--direct`
# channel keeps the `./…` form because there the body IS staged before dsh
# starts. Both forms are generated from one composition; see
# scripts/lib/preset-declaration.mjs and scripts/check-preset-body-lists.mjs.
- insert:
    - id: math-memory-host
      name: dsh-math-memory

# >>> GENERATED agent-preset declaration (scripts/build-preset-declaration.mjs) >>>
# ⚠️ GENERATED from dsh/preset/agent.cordis.yml + preset.yml — do not edit by hand.
# Regenerate with: node scripts/build-preset-declaration.mjs
#
# dsh 0.1.7 declares agent presets as ordinary Cordis rows (directory-based
# presets are gone). This copy names the preset's modules as SUBPATHS OF THE
# INSTALLED PACKAGE (`dsh-math-memory/dsh/preset/…`), because a bundle row cannot stage files
# into the profile directory early enough on a cold first boot — the registry
# mounts the preset while the host row is still importing (measured 2026-09-26).
#
# Both channels are generated from ONE composition; scripts/check-preset-body-lists.mjs
# fails when a form drifts.
- insert:
  - id: preset-notes-assistant
    name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
    config:
      id: notes-assistant
      name: "数学笔记助手"
      description: "面向数学类笔记的最小 agent：专用笔记工具（note_recall 统一检索）+ 跨会话分层记忆 + 每日记忆体检。试做型，记忆架构仍在演进。"
      order: 1
      plugins:
      - id: persona
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
        config:
          prefix: >-
            You are the user's long-term Obsidian knowledge-base assistant for
            mathematical (and adjacent: statistics, R/LaTeX) notes and
            research thinking, powered by the {{model}} model. Your working
            directory is the user's Obsidian vault.

            You are a thinking-and-writing partner, not a general coding agent:
            read the user's notes before answering, keep their notation and
            theoretical preferences, surface key ideas worth capturing, and keep a
            durable memory so future conversations start from where the last one
            ended. You are also a study companion: intuition before formalism,
            anchor new material to the user's existing notes, and adapt depth to
            their current level (see AGENTS.md's reply-quality principles). You may
            only read and modify files inside the vault through the provided file
            tools. For every significant piece of new information about the user's
            interests, terminology, or preferences, update the memory files under
            `.deepseek/` (see AGENTS.md in the vault root for the exact protocol).
            Never invent facts about the user's notes; read first.

      - id: agent-instructions
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
        config:
          maxBytes: 65536

      # ── minimal tools ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      - id: tool-fs
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'

      - id: tool-fs-search
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
        config:
          sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

      # Asking the user is part of the key-idea capture contract: propose first,
      # write to the memo only after consent (or an explicit standing consent).
      - id: tool-ask-user
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'

      # ── cross-session memory injection + dedicated note tools ────────────────────

      # Local plugin: reads the vault's `.deepseek/memory/*` and `.deepseek/inbox/*`
      # plus a cached index distilled from this machine's past dsh sessions, and
      # appends one bounded memory section to every system prompt of this agent.
      #
      # It also applies ./note-tools.mjs on the same context. Because this
      # plugin's code is always refreshed on upgrade (while this YAML preserves user
      # edits), composing the note tools from here is what lets existing 0.2.0
      # installations pick up note_search / note_create / note_links automatically.
      - id: math-memory
        name: dsh-math-memory/dsh/preset/math-memory.mjs
        config:
          # 记忆系统总开关：false = 完全停用（不注入 / 不体检 / 不扫对话索引；文件与缓存原样保留）。
          # 只想在学数学时才开记忆时设为 false；笔记工具（note_recall 等）不受影响、始终可用。
          enabled: true
          # 行为粒度开关（enabled 为 true 时生效）：
          #   dialogueIndex: false = 不扫描历史会话生成跨会话问答线索（隐私/性能）
          #   reminders: false     = 不在回复里注入 🔔 备忘录提醒候选
          dialogueIndex: true
          reminders: true
          # 留空 = 路径无关：vault 自动取会话 cwd，sessions 自动取 $DSH_HOME/sessions。
          # 也可用 DSH_OBSIDIAN_VAULT / DSH_SESSIONS_ROOT 环境变量覆盖。
          vaultRoot: ''
          sessionsRoot: ''
          maxHistoryEntries: 40
          maxHistoryChars: 8000
          cacheTtlMs: 0
          # 记忆体检（memory v2，ISM 式确定性维护 pass）：扫描 records/templates 的
          # frontmatter 与 hook 字段，每日最多一次（auditIntervalMs 毫秒），报告注入
          # 系统提示；同时把 note_recall 的命中统计（cache/retrieval-stats.json）
          # 回写进卡片的 hook.uses / hook.last_used（可关：auditMaintainHookStats: false）。
          auditEnabled: true
          auditIntervalMs: 86400000
          auditMaintainHookStats: true
          # 自动归档（self-correction.md P3）：true = 体检把「零使用 + 长期陈旧(>90天) + 非用户确认」
          # 的卡移入 .deepseek/archive/<层>/（移动而非删除，可逆、有 .bak，随时可找回）。
          # 2026-09-18 起默认 **true**：用户明确要求「把耗费时间的平凡工作做掉」，而逐张点「归档」
          # 正是那种平凡工作；判据本身极窄（零使用 + 90 天 + 非用户确认），且这是移动不是删除。
          # 想回到「只建议不归档」就在工作区 .deepseek/config.md 写 autoArchive: false。
          autoArchive: true
          # 自动保存对话（obelisk-comparison.md §5）：false = 不自动把整场对话写进证据层（默认关，
          # 避免不经用户同意就记录一大堆）；true = 每场对话结束后，确定性把整场对话（不含思考）
          # 写进 .deepseek/memory/episodes/ 证据层。
          sessionCapture: false
          # 子代理会话是否也保存：false = 跳过（默认）。子代理（可继续对话的 subagent）会话会重放
          # 父会话的前缀，保存它等于把同一场对话重复写进证据层、并稀释每轮注入预算。dsh ≥ 0.1.5 的
          # V3 头部带 origin: subagent / delegationDepth，据此判定；V2 头部没有这两个字段，无法区分，
          # 因此旧格式一律保留。true = 连子代理会话一起保存。
          captureSubagents: false
          # 检索 v3（S5）：系统提示只注入导航层（主题/记录/模板/事件索引 = “有什么”），
          # 相关内容按需用 note_recall 拉取，不再逐轮注入 top-k 召回。
          notes:
            # 留空 = 路径无关：vault 自动取会话 cwd 或 DSH_OBSIDIAN_VAULT。
            vaultRoot: ''
            maxSearchResults: 50
            maxNoteBytes: 1048576
            excludePatterns: ['.obsidian', '.trash', '.git', 'node_modules']
# <<< END GENERATED agent-preset declaration <<<

readme.text:
[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

> A math-notes assistant that lives in Obsidian's right sidebar and remembers what you were working on between sessions.

Most chat assistants forget everything when a conversation ends. This one keeps your notes and a long-term memory inside your own vault, so a new session can pick up where the last one stopped. Everything stays on your machine.

- **Remembers across sessions.** It keeps a profile, typed memory cards, idea memos and raw conversation evidence in `.deepseek/`, all as plain Markdown you can read and edit.
- **Finds things in one search.** `note_recall` searches your notes and all memory layers together, then reads the best hits before answering.
- **Lets you review and correct.** A memory panel shows what it knows; each card can be confirmed, marked wrong or archived, and replies link back to the cards they used.
- **Stays out of the way.** Notes stay in your vault, the service listens on localhost only, and the assistant has no shell, no web access and no delete tools.

Version **0.8.3**, still a prototype. The "remember, find, correct" loop works end to end. What is still missing is the harder half: helping you build mathematical understanding — knowing where you are stuck, what to practise next, and how to reuse your own techniques. That is what 1.0 means. The current state and open work are kept in [docs/README.md](docs/README.md).

**A. From Obsidian (recommended).** Settings → Community plugins → Browse, search **DSH Math Notes Assistant**, then install and enable it. On first run the plugin finds DeepSeek Harness, sets up its configuration and vault templates, and starts the service.

**B. From the command line.**

```bash
npm install -g dsh-math-memory
dsh-math-memory install --vault "<path-to-your-vault>"
dsh --profile notes-assistant --port 3180
```

**C. Manually.** Download `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` from the [latest release](https://github.com/maple110011/dsh-obsidian-math/releases) and copy them into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/dsh-math-assistant/`.

- Obsidian desktop and Node.js 22.5 or newer.
- DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`, **requires ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2**) with a configured DeepSeek model.
- Default port 3180. The regular dsh web uses 3080; the two can run at the same time.

```text
vault/
  AGENTS.md                     working agreement, loaded automatically
  .deepseek/
    memory/profile.md           who you are and how you like to work

Open the sidebar and start a conversation. At the start of each session the assistant reads `AGENTS.md` and the memory index. To see or correct what it remembers, open the memory panel; to change what is captured automatically, use the capture-policy row in the panel or the plugin settings.

- Current state and open work: [docs/README.md](docs/README.md)
- How the two components fit together: [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)
- Install and release details: [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md), [docs/release.md](docs/release.md)
- Why decisions were made: [docs/changelog.md](docs/changelog.md)
- Before changing memory or retrieval: [docs/memory/README.md](docs/memory/README.md)
- The agent's tools: four note tools (`note_recall`, `note_strategy`, `note_create`, `note_links`) plus file read/write/search.

Development commands:

```bash
npm test          # syntax + 478 zero-token regression checks + 69 route-level checks + 8 real-dsh handshake checks + 24 loopback-proxy checks + installer e2e (drift detection)
npm run qa        # engine probe (no API cost)
node scripts/build-obsidian.mjs   # rebuild main.js after changing shared files
```

- Version: **0.8.3**
Everything runs locally: the service binds to 127.0.0.1, memory is Markdown inside your vault, and the session index never leaves the machine.
